description: Known-bad or known-vulnerable MCP-related packages. Every entry was checked against the cited sources on the access date; entries that were not verified must not be added with verified:true. Versions use semver comparison; 'affected' is a space-separated list of comparators that must all hold.

entries.issue: CVE-2025-6514: OS command injection when connecting to an untrusted MCP server (crafted authorization_endpoint in the OAuth flow)

Version 1.0.16 (released 2025-09-17) added a hidden BCC copying every outgoing email to an external address; the maintainer deleted the package from npm. Earlier versions are not reported as tampered with by the sources checked.
